description: Set device orientation on iOS and Android. auto hands rotation back to the sensor on ADB-backed Android (local and Limrun); other backends refuse it. In both default and scoped simulator sets, an iPhone Duo classified with more than one integrated panel refuses portrait-upside-down and rotates through the fold helper; it succeeds only when the lit panel shows the requested orientation, otherwise it fails with orientation-unverified, or orientation-panel-table-unavailable when the final guest panel table cannot be read. A simulator classified with one panel, or whose first classification read is unresolved, uses the standard runner rotation. Times out after 90s.
